title: Mono Lake's 3 Unbelievable Pink Secrets

scenes.text: Mono Lake’s pink sand reveals 3 mind‑blowing facts!
scenes.query: Mono Lake pink sand lake close up

scenes.label: ALGAE ALARM
scenes.text: Extremely salty conditions support Dunaliella algae, giving the sand a vivid pink hue.
scenes.query: Mono Lake salt algae pink lake

scenes.label: STONE STORMS
scenes.text: The lake’s limestone towers, called tufa, rise from the water, creating a surreal skyline.

scenes.label: CLEAN ENERGY
scenes.text: The lake’s high salinity prevents most fish from surviving, making it a unique ecological niche.
scenes.query: Mono Lake salt lake fish absence

scenes.text: Follow for the planet's best-kept secrets.

description: From pink sand to towering tufa spires, Mono Lake is a living laboratory of nature’s creativity. Discover the science that makes it so extraordinary. Follow for more awe‑inspiring places!
